name: Shibetsu (Japan, town)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shibetsu town emblem in purple: a broken ring enclosing a stylised four-pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Shibetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1958.

features.role: Shibetsu town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised four-pointed device
